title: Underway Hoists Explained
description: Petty Officer 2nd Class Nick Broaddus, a flight mechanic at Coast Guard Air Station Atlantic City, N.J., answers questions at the air station Monday, June 22, 2015, explaining why hoists from boats are preferably done while underway. Broaddus and his fellow air crew members had performed a hoist over the previous weekend with the charter fishing vessel, Last Dollar, and members of the public inquired as to why the boat was moving in the hoist video. U.S. Coast Guard video by Chief Petty Officer Nick Ameen.
